body:
OPERATOR APPROVED. Recorded as ADR-49, draft — yours to accept, and the reviewer has standing to object because it changes their contract.

WHAT WAS ADOPTED:

  1. Split the verdict, do not defer it. Behaviour defects BLOCK; acceptance and test gaps file
     a child spec and MERGE.
  2. Deferred findings carry a BUDGET — the drain stops accepting new work above a threshold.
  3. The regression suite is NOT promoted to sole gate.
  4. STORY-1391 is a prerequisite.

WHAT WAS REJECTED FROM THE ORIGINAL, with the reasons recorded so they are not re-litigated: tests as a separate commit at the back of the queue (starves, and the suite stops growing while main grows); deferred findings as ordinary bugs (the 408 in BUG-1498 are what that becomes); release as the forcing function (ADR-47 defers releases, so it would never fire).

THE TWO MEASUREMENTS ARE IN THE ADR AND THE SECOND IS THE ONE THAT DECIDED IT:

    findings in open CHANGES-REQUESTED verdicts
      acceptance unmet  32 (41%)    behaviour defect 16 (21%)
      other             26 (33%)    test gap          4 ( 5%)

    rejected PRs, build status
      green 44    red 3    unknown 1

The suite passes on 92% of what review rejects. It is orthogonal to review, not a weaker version of it — so gating on it would have admitted essentially everything. That number also says review is catching something tests structurally cannot, which is the argument for keeping it in a modified form rather than backgrounding it.

THREE CONSEQUENCES I WROTE IN AS ACCEPTED RATHER THAN OVERLOOKED, because each is a way this decision does damage quietly:

  - Some defects WILL merge. 21% is the floor of what the split must catch correctly; anything
    misclassified as deferrable ships. That is deliberate.
  - The reviewer's contract changes. Blocking-vs-deferrable becomes an explicit judgment, and
    mis-classifying downward is the new failure mode.
  - The budget threshold is a number nobody has evidence for. Pick one, observe, adjust — and
    say so rather than defending the first guess.

WHAT I WOULD ASK OF YOU, in order: accept or amend ADR-49; then decide whether the split lands as a new verdict kind or as a field on the existing one. The second is not a detail — a new kind is greppable and a field is not, and we spent today discovering how much of this system reasons by matching prose.
